objective: Build an Expo Router BUKLOD FIS finance information workspace without a second ledger, duplicated money logic or unapproved cash activation
productionBaselineEvidence: verified: Inspected exact GitHub main source SHA 66b3eefaeae7f9f136a98fdef08e1cba2ecfb742 on 2026-11-15 as the DEV comparison baseline. This is NOT verification of the current Expo Hosting live artifact, Android production runtime, or deployed source. No production deployment performed.
chosenApproach: System-admin-only Expo web/native route; read-only view over canonical Finance V3 and existing withdrawal RPC. Navigate to existing authority for mutations.
preserveBehaviors: No new tables, allocation math, authentication pathways or payout switches
Member QMP/Points remain non-cash without finalized funded settlement
Server-side RLS/RPC authority unchanged; no payout destination export
No change to BUKLOD Main ads, video, Community, Connect, health, Kingdom or native SDK/runtime
Standalone FIS production must use separate EAS_PROJECT_ID_FIS, never Main or Classroom fallback
BUKLOD Main landing, login and native runtime remain unchanged unless EXPO_PUBLIC_BUKLOD_FIS=1
Expo FIS production promotion uses the identical verified immutable preview deployment ID
BUKLOD FIS is pinned to newly created EAS project de578117-37fb-4c4d-8fec-d472e08b117f; any other project fails before build
acceptanceChecks: Manila month selection and refresh reject stale RPC results
Export CSV formula-injection guarded and capped
TypeScript and Expo web export pass on exact PR SHA before any publish
FIS hosting identity, explicit project ID and standalone site root/login contract enforced
Preview and production exact-artifact release checks before declaring published
Dedicated FIS Expo project registered under @faust_0612; exact UUID enforced in app config, CI and focused regression tests
alternativeApproaches: Parallel FIS database rejected: conflicts with Finance V3 source of truth
Separate Expo app with duplicate Supabase auth rejected due to cost, repeated login and account isolation
Auto-finalization/withdrawal activation rejected without evidence and independent server gates

lockedFeatureChanges.reason: Isolate FIS-only Expo web identity and authenticated routing through a distinct project and build-time flags, while preserving BUKLOD Main default app/runtime/login and canonical Finance V3.
preservedBehaviors: Main project ID, normal boot routing and native runtime unchanged by default
Standalone FIS project ID required; reject Main/Classroom IDs
Existing protected finance RPCs, System Administrator authorization and app modules unchanged

lockedFeatureChanges.reason: FIS hosting alone routes login and index into a protected finance workspace while Main authentication, Public Home and session flows keep their original behavior.
preservedBehaviors: BUKLOD Main login still directs to the existing Public Home
Existing authenticated Supabase session and system-admin-only authorization protect FIS
FIS root does not leak sensitive finance data to anonymous or non-admin sessions

lockedFeatureChanges.reason: Add isolated FIS Expo project bootstrap, CI verification, preview hosting and exact immutable artifact promotion without triggering BUKLOD Main workflows.
preservedBehaviors: BUKLOD Main EAS project ID and Expo OTA channel never used for FIS hosting
No production promotion before focused QA and FIS preview HTTP verification
Expo FIS public runtime uses only Supabase publishable key, never financial service-role credentials

selectionRationale: Existing Finance V3 authoritative RPC already provides reconciled bookkeeping, monthly close controls and payouts; a read-only Expo admin module is cheaper and safer than a new backend, app or ledger. The new route reuses current protected auth and does not create any monetary write permissions.
